review: Scorecard: no round has finished since the last report (R12 starts tonight), so nothing new to grade; R11 stands at 168 for your team with Vezenkov's 57 as captain. Yesterday's two open checks both came good: Kamenjas is registered with Baskonia, and Rogkavopoulos is in Panathinaikos's squad, so the plan stands unchanged rather than flip-flopping. Bookmaker lines this morning back Masiulis (ZAL) (−9.5) over Jasikevičius (ULK) (−11.5 but two forwards down) and lower Olympiacos to about 70%, which slightly trims Vezenkov's win bonus but not his captaincy. window_plan: Unlimited trades before R14 (21–24 Nov). The rebuild's best plan sells Nunn, Brizuela, Malcolm and Joksimović for Payne, Frisch, Procida and Maledon, with coach Martínez (MAD): about 6.4% a round over R14–R16, against about 2.5% if you keep this squad. I agree with the direction, but Procida (PIR 0 on Sunday) and Frisch (−2) need a good R12 before I'd buy them, and Maledon only once he's past 20 minutes without the knee brace. Before the window, spend R13's 4 trades on R13 only (Nunn → Hifi first); I'll re-check on Wednesday night with the new prices.
